author: blu
body: It used to publish [Device.Mmio], and that word grants the whole Device family: every BAR on the bus and the block device with it. A program that wanted to beep asked for the authority to drive the disk controller, because that was the only word available for reaching a register. The authority to play a note is now its own bit and its own manifest entry -- a verifier reading a CDX can tell a program that makes a sound from a program that can rewrite the disk, which it could not do before.

author: blu
body: Capture keeps [Device.Mmio] deliberately, and it is not an oversight: reading the microphone is Microphone's authority, MicInput publishes it under that name, and MicInput grounds Device.Mmio itself. Giving capture the Audio bit would let the right to SPEAK buy the right to LISTEN.
